! Game text
| Deploy on one pilot aboard a starfighter just lost at a system. Pilot ‘drifts’ without presence at that system (until captured or rescued by a capital starship) and does not participate in battles or attacks, but may be targeted by starship weapons (maneuver = 0). || {{Errata hl|1=If}} a starfighter {{Errata hl|1=was}} just lost at a system {{Errata hl|1=or sector, return one of its pilots there}} ({{Errata hl|1=deploy on pilot}} until captured or rescued by a capital starship){{Errata hl|1=. Has no presence. Does}} not participate in battles or attacks{{Errata hl|1=. Targetable}} by starship weapons ({{Errata hl|1=defense value}} = 0). || If a {{Errata hl|1=pilot}} was just lost {{Errata hl|1=from}} a system or sector, deploy on {{Errata hl|1=that location and stack}} pilot {{Errata hl|1=here. Pilot may be rescued or}} captured by {{Errata hl|1=any}} capital starship {{Errata hl|1=present here during any move phase, and may be targeted}} by weapons ({{Errata hl|1=except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with}} defense value = 0). {{Errata hl|1=Lost if no pilot here.}} || If a pilot was just lost from a system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here. Pilot may be rescued or captured by any capital starship present here during any move phase, and may be targeted by weapons (except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value = 0). Lost if no pilot here. || If a pilot was just lost from a system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here. Pilot may be rescued or captured by any capital starship present here during any move phase, and may be targeted by weapons (except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value = 0). Lost if no pilot here. || If a pilot was just lost from a system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here. Pilot may be rescued or captured by any capital starship present here during any move phase, and may be targeted by weapons (except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value = 0). Lost if no pilot here. || If a pilot was just lost from a system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here. Pilot may be rescued or captured by any capital starship present here during any move phase, and may be targeted by weapons (except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value = 0). Lost if no pilot here.

== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Lost In Space]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
